root_cause: The previous nextCriterion matcher required the plan/time marker and concrete action in the same sentence, so it missed an immediately adjacent plan-setting sentence followed by a targeted action.

method.red_1: The exact clean attempt-2 structure failed only the new positive nextCriterion assertion.
method.green_1: An adjacency-bounded helper recognized a plan-setting sentence followed immediately by a particle-marked concrete action.
method.red_2: A new counterexample showed that the action prefix in '기록해 보지 마' was incorrectly accepted.
method.green_2: The helper now rejects negated action suffixes while retaining the real attempt-2 positive.
method.review_hardening: Independent review added concrete-target enforcement to same-sentence candidates, prefix/topic negation, past/perfect auxiliaries, morphologically bounded abandonment, safe anti-abandonment, and logistics counterexamples.
